name: syndex
description: Worker serving the Synthesizer data API and the Syndex portal.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/assets/syndex/static && tailwindcss --input src/portal/app.css --output dist/assets/syndex/static/app.css --minify && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js dist/assets/syndex/static/htmx.min.js && cp src/portal/filters.js src/portal/upload.js src/portal/preview.js src/portal/syndex_logo_2.png dist/assets/syndex/static/
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply synthesizer-database --local && wrangler dev
